rationale: Honduras is published on a never-assessed uniform seed vector (2/2/2/1.5/2/1.5/2/1.5, composite 20.3) shared byte-identically by twelve countries at ranks 134-145. This full 40-subdimension assessment replaces the seed with evidence and returns 26.9, a difference of +6.6 points.
